optionsSubHeader.title: Vyhľadávajte a prehliadajte web bez toho, aby vás sledovali.
optionsSubHeader.note: We allow the user to browse the web without being followed by trackers

blockSitesTab.title: Blokovať weby
blockSitesTab.note: Navigation tab for managing completely blocked websites

allowedSitesTab.title: Povolené weby
allowedSitesTab.note: Navigation tab for managing websites that are explicitly allowed

allowedSitesHeading.title: Povolené weby
allowedSitesHeading.note: Header for the list of websites that stay allowed

allowedSitesIntro.title: Pridajte web(y) na povolenie do poľa nižšie a kliknite na „Pridať povolený web / povolené weby“. Tipy:
allowedSitesIntro.note: Instructions for adding websites to the allowed list

allowedSitesTipMultiple.title: Ak chcete povoliť viacero webov, pridajte jeden na riadok.
allowedSitesTipMultiple.note: Tip explaining that each allowed website should be on its own line

allowedSitesTipWildcard.title: Môžete použiť * ako zástupný znak (napr. *.youtube.com, *.edu alebo *docs*). Vzory ako *.com alebo *.co.uk sú príliš široké a nie sú povolené.
allowedSitesTipWildcard.note: Tip explaining wildcard matching and that public suffixes are rejected

allowedSitesPlaceholder.title: Zadajte weby sem...
allowedSitesPlaceholder.note: Placeholder for the allowed websites text box

addAllowedSites.title: Pridať povolený web / povolené weby
addAllowedSites.note: Button that adds the websites in the text box to the allowed list

allowedSitesRemoveHint.title: Kliknutím na × odstránite web zo zoznamu.
allowedSitesRemoveHint.note: Explains how to remove a website from the allowed list

removeAllowedSite.title: Odstrániť {pattern}
removeAllowedSite.note: Accessible label for removing an allowed website. {pattern} is the website or wildcard.

clearAllAllowedSites.title: Vymazať všetko
clearAllAllowedSites.note: Button that removes every website from the allowed list

clearAllAllowedConfirm.title: Odstrániť všetky weby z Povolených webov?
clearAllAllowedConfirm.note: Confirmation shown before clearing the allowed list

allowedSitesNote.title: Weby z Povolených webov môžete odstrániť kedykoľvek, aj keď čas už vypršal.
allowedSitesNote.note: Explains that allowed sites can be removed even after a group's daily time is used up

allowedSiteConflict.title: {domain} je v skupine {groupName}. Najprv ho odstráňte z Blokovať weby.
allowedSiteConflict.note: Error when an allowed website overlaps a grouped website. {domain} is the grouped site. {groupName} is the group name.

allowedSiteInvalid.title: „{line}“ nie je platný web ani zástupný znak.
allowedSiteInvalid.note: Error when an allowed website entry cannot be parsed. {line} is the original input.

allowedSiteTooBroad.title: „{line}“ je príliš široké. Povoľte konkrétny web, napríklad *.youtube.com namiesto *.com.
allowedSiteTooBroad.note: Error when an allowed pattern would match a whole public suffix. {line} is the original input.

allowedSiteEmpty.title: Zadajte aspoň jeden web.
allowedSiteEmpty.note: Error shown when the allowed sites text box is empty

allowedSitesSaveError.title: Povolené weby sa nepodarilo uložiť.
allowedSitesSaveError.note: Error shown when adding allowed websites fails unexpectedly

addToGroupRemovesAllowed.title: Pridanie {domain} do tejto skupiny odstráni tieto povolené weby: {patterns}.
addToGroupRemovesAllowed.note: Confirmation before moving a site from the allowed list into a group. {domain} is the website being added. {patterns} is the list of allowed entries that will be deleted.

confirmAddToGroup.title: Pridať do skupiny
confirmAddToGroup.note: Confirms adding a website to a group and removing overlapping allowed entries

sanctuaryHeading.title: Režim Sanctuary
sanctuaryHeading.note: Header for the Sanctuary Mode settings on the Allowed Sites page

sanctuaryDesc.title: Keď je režim Sanctuary aktívny, dajú sa používať len weby z Povolených webov. Všetky ostatné sú zablokované bez výnimiek. Nedá sa vypnúť, kým nevyprší nastavený čas.
sanctuaryDesc.note: Explains that Sanctuary Mode is a lock that allows only the allowed list until the timer ends

sanctuaryDuration.title: Trvanie
sanctuaryDuration.note: Label for how long Sanctuary Mode stays on after it is activated

sanctuaryShowOnPopup.title: Zobraziť režim Sanctuary vo vyskakovacom okne
sanctuaryShowOnPopup.note: Toggle that reveals the Activate Sanctuary Mode button in the extension popup

sanctuaryShowOnPopupDesc.title: Pridá do vyskakovacieho okna tlačidlo Aktivovať. Režim sa spustí až po stlačení tohto tlačidla.
sanctuaryShowOnPopupDesc.note: Explains that the toggle does not start Sanctuary Mode by itself

sanctuaryActiveNote.title: Režim Sanctuary je zapnutý. Povolené weby a tieto nastavenia sú uzamknuté na {remaining}.
sanctuaryActiveNote.note: Shown while Sanctuary Mode is running. {remaining} is the countdown, e.g. 1:05:00.

sanctuaryLockedError.title: Režim Sanctuary je zapnutý. Toto sa nedá zmeniť, kým časovač neskončí.
sanctuaryLockedError.note: Error when the user tries to edit Allowed Sites or Sanctuary settings during a lock

blockTrackersTab.title: Blokovať sledovače
blockTrackersTab.note: Navigation tab for OpenFocusd tracker-blocking and privacy options

optionsDesc.title:
OpenFocusd a DuckDuckGo chránia vaše súkromie online pomocou
súkromného vyhľadávania,
blokovania sledovania
a šifrovania lokalít.
optionsDesc.note: This describes how we protect the user from being tracked online

shareFeedback.title: Zdieľať spätnú väzbu
shareFeedback.note: Click here to share your opinions about this product

reportBrokenSite.title: Nahlásiť nefunkčnú lokalitu
reportBrokenSite.note: Click here to report an issue with a specific site you are trying to use

showEmbeddedTweets.title: Zobraziť vložené tweety
showEmbeddedTweets.note: Whether the user wants to see Tweets embedded in various webpages or should they be hidden util clicked on

globalPrivacyControlAbbr.title: Globálna kontrola súkromia (GPC)
globalPrivacyControlAbbr.note: Global Privacy Control is the name of the feature that lets users set a preference to not have their information sold

globalPrivacyControlDesc.title:
Vaše údaje nesmú byť na predaj. V OpenFocusd s tým súhlasíme. Aktivujte nastavenia „Globálne ovládanie ochrany súkromia” (GPC) a my budeme
signalizovať webovým lokalitám vaše preferencie, aby:
globalPrivacyControlDesc.note: This describes the GPC feature, which lets the user set a preference to not have their personal information sold by websites to other parties. The string is followed by a list of actions like 'Not sell your personal data'. These are translated separately.

notSellYourPersonalData.title: nepredávali vaše osobné údaje,
notSellYourPersonalData.note: Part of the GPC description, this communicates that the user would signal to not SELL their personal data

limitSharingOfPersonalData.title: obmedzili zdieľanie vašich osobných údajov s inými spoločnosťami.
limitSharingOfPersonalData.note: Part of the GPC description, this communicates that the user would signal to not SHARE their personal data

globalPrivacyControlDisclaimer.title: Pretože „Globálne ovládanie ochrany súkromia” (GPC) je novým štandardom, väčšina webových stránok ho ešte nerozpozná, ale usilovne pracujeme na tom, aby sa stal celosvetovo akceptovaným. Od webových stránok sa však vyžaduje, aby konali na základe signálu iba v rozsahu, v akom to od nich vyžadujú príslušné zákony.
globalPrivacyControlDisclaimer.note: Explains to the user that we can communicate their choice to the website, but the website needs to choose to support this signal

emailProtection.title: Ochrana e-mailu
emailProtection.note: Email protection is a feature that lets the user pick private email addresses for different websites

autofillDisabled.title: Automatické vypĺňanie je vypnuté
autofillDisabled.note: When we don't automatically help populate email fields with a private address

autofillEnabled.title: Automatické vypĺňanie je povolené pre {userName}
autofillEnabled.note: When we do help populate email addresses for (your email address here)

noUnprotectedSitesAdded.title: Neboli pridané žiadne nechránené lokality
noUnprotectedSitesAdded.note: Currently there are no websites on the list of websites where our privacy protections are disabled

unprotectedSites.title: Nezabezpečené webové stránky
unprotectedSites.note: Header for the list of websites where our privacy protections are disabled

unprotectedSitesDesc.title: Tieto webové stránky nebudú rozšírené o ochranu súkromia.
unprotectedSitesDesc.note: Describes that the user will not be protected by our privacy features when visiting these websites

addUnprotectedSite.title: Pridanie nechránenej lokality
addUnprotectedSite.note: Header for the user to add a site to the unprotected list

enterURL.title: Zadajte adresu URL
enterURL.note: Prompt to enter the website URL here

invalidURL.title: Neplatná adresa URL
invalidURL.note: The URL the user entered is not a valid website address

blockedSites.title: Blokované weby
blockedSites.note: Header for the list of websites the user wants to block completely

groupsTitle.title: Skupiny
groupsTitle.note: Header for website groups that share a daily time limit

groupsDesc.title: Každá skupina má spoločný denný časový limit. Na webe zo skupiny čas odpočítava. Pri nule sú všetky weby v skupine zablokované do 6:00.
groupsDesc.note: Explains that grouped websites share one daily allowance

addGroup.title: Pridať skupinu
addGroup.note: Button that creates a new website group

groupName.title: Názov
groupName.note: Label for the website group name field

maxTimeAllowed.title: Max. čas za deň
maxTimeAllowed.note: Label for the shared daily time limit

saveGroup.title: Uložiť zmeny
saveGroup.note: Button that saves a group's name and daily time limit

groupSaved.title: Skupina uložená.
groupSaved.note: Confirmation shown after a group is saved

groupSaveError.title: Skupinu sa nepodarilo uložiť.
groupSaveError.note: Error shown when saving a group fails

deleteGroup.title: Odstrániť skupinu
deleteGroup.note: Button that deletes a website group

deleteGroupConfirm.title: Odstrániť skupinu {name}?
deleteGroupConfirm.note: Yes/No confirmation before deleting a website group. {name} is the group name.

confirmNo.title: Nie
confirmNo.note: Cancels the current dialog without making a change

groupBlockedWebsites.title: Blokované weby
groupBlockedWebsites.note: Header for websites assigned to a group

adultGamblingHeading.title: Stránky pre dospelých a hazard
adultGamblingHeading.note: Section header on Always Block for the optional adult and gambling category list

adultGamblingToggle.title: Blokovať stránky pre dospelých a hazard
adultGamblingToggle.note: Toggle that enables the bundled adult and gambling host list

adultGamblingListLink.title: (viac ako 52-tisíc webov)
adultGamblingListLink.note: Link next to the adult and gambling toggle; opens the source hosts list

adultGamblingDesc.title: Keď je toto zapnuté, tieto weby sú vždy blokované a otvárajú rovnakú blokovaciu stránku ako weby pridané nižšie. Povolené weby môžu aj tak urobiť výnimku.
adultGamblingDesc.note: Explains the adult and gambling category switch on Always Block

adultGamblingDisableConfirm.title: Ak chcete vypnúť blokovanie stránok pre dospelých a hazard, vyriešte:
adultGamblingDisableConfirm.note: Prompt before disabling the adult and gambling list. The user must answer a two-digit multiplication problem.

adultGamblingDisableMath.title: {a} × {b} =
adultGamblingDisableMath.note: Two-digit multiplication problem shown before adult and gambling blocking can be turned off

confirmDisableAdultGambling.title: Vypnúť
confirmDisableAdultGambling.note: Submits the math answer and turns off adult and gambling blocking if it is correct

addBlockedWebsite.title: Pridať web
addBlockedWebsite.note: Button that adds a website to the current group

addWebsitePlaceholder.title: example.com
addWebsitePlaceholder.note: Placeholder for the website field in a group

removeWebsite.title: Odstrániť web
removeWebsite.note: Accessible label for removing a website from a group

removeWebsiteConfirm.title: Ak chcete odstrániť {domain}, vyriešte:
removeWebsiteConfirm.note: Prompt before removing a website. {domain} is the website address. The user must answer an addition problem.

removeWebsiteMath.title: {a} + {b} =
removeWebsiteMath.note: Two-digit addition problem shown before a website can be removed

removeWebsiteMathWrong.title: To nie je správna odpoveď.
removeWebsiteMathWrong.note: Error shown when the removal math problem is answered incorrectly

confirmCancel.title: Zrušiť
confirmCancel.note: Closes the website removal confirmation without removing the site

confirmRemove.title: Odstrániť
confirmRemove.note: Submits the math answer and removes the website if it is correct

noGroupedWebsites.title: V tejto skupine zatiaľ nie sú žiadne weby.
noGroupedWebsites.note: Empty state for a group with no assigned websites

timeLeft.title: Zostávajúci čas
timeLeft.note: Label inside the remaining-time indicator for a group

groupLockedUntilReset.title: Čas vypršal. Názov, čas a existujúce weby sú uzamknuté do 6:00. Stále môžete pridávať weby.
groupLockedUntilReset.note: Shown on a group that has used its daily time. Time and existing sites cannot be changed until 6:00, but new websites can still be added.

groupLockedError.title: Túto skupinu nie je možné meniť do 6:00.
groupLockedError.note: Error shown when a locked group is edited

invalidWebsite.title: Zadajte platnú adresu webu.
invalidWebsite.note: Error shown when a grouped website entry is invalid

searchEngine.title: Vyhľadávač
searchEngine.note: Header for choosing DuckDuckGo or Brave as the private search engine

searchEngineDesc.title: Vyberte, kam pôjdu vyhľadávania z vyskakovacieho okna a kľúčového slova v adresnom riadku.
searchEngineDesc.note: Explains that the selected search engine is used by the extension popup and omnibox keyword

searchEngineDuckDuckGo.title: DuckDuckGo
searchEngineDuckDuckGo.note: Label for the DuckDuckGo search engine option. Product name, do not translate.

searchEngineBrave.title: Brave Search
searchEngineBrave.note: Label for the Brave Search engine option. Product name, do not translate.

noAiMode.title: Bez umelej inteligencie vo vyhľadávaní
noAiMode.note: Toggle to redirect DuckDuckGo searches to the no-AI variant (noai.duckduckgo.com)

noAiModeDesc.title: Zobraziť výsledky vyhľadávania bez odpovedí s umelou inteligenciou (Search Assist) alebo chatov s umelou inteligenciou (Duck.ai), a štandardne filtrovať obrázky generované umelou inteligenciou z výsledkov vyhľadávania obrázkov. Vzťahuje sa to na všetky vyhľadávania z duckduckgo.com a z riadku s adresou.
noAiModeDesc.note: Description text explaining what the No AI in Searches toggle does. 'Search Assist' and 'Duck.ai' are product names and should not be translated.
